text: 1、市场早间震荡调整，创业板指跌超1%，宁德时代跌超10%。福建本地股逆势走强，平潭发展、福建水泥、安记食品等涨停。数据要素表现活跃，南威软件、星光股份4天3板，海量数据、天威视讯涨停。CPO概念股拉升，天阳新材涨停，致尚科技涨超15%。下跌方面，电池产业链集体下挫，时代万恒触及跌停。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超2800股飘红，上午半天成交9486亿。午间收盘沪指跌0.31%，深成指跌0.31%，创业板跌1.07%。 2、板块概念方面，福建、传媒影视、CPO、算力租赁等板块领涨；电池、教育、美容护理、汽车整车等板块领跌； 3、两市共2808只个股上涨，44
text_en: 1. The market fluctuated and adjusted in the morning session, with the ChiNext Index falling more than 1% and CATL dropping more than 10%. Fujian local stocks strengthened against the trend, with Pingtan Development, Fujian Cement, and Anji Food hitting the limit up. Data elements performed actively, with Nanwei Software and Xingguang Shares hitting the limit up for the third time in four days, while Hailiang Data and Tianwei Video hit the limit up. CPO concept stocks surged, with Tianyang New Materials hitting the limit up and Zhishang Technology rising more than 15%. On the downside, the battery industry chain fell collectively, with Shidai Wanheng touching the limit down. More individual stocks rose than fell, with over 2,800 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets trading higher, and turnover reaching 948.6 billion yuan in the morning session. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.31%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.31%, and ChiNext fell 1.07%. 2. In terms of sectors and concepts, Fujian, media and film, CPO, and computing power leasing sectors led the gains; battery, education, beauty care, and complete vehicle sectors led the declines. 3.
